source.name: Ministarstvo finansija Republike Srbije – Imenik licenciranih procenitelja (xlsx)

note: 288 rows from 279 licensed appraisers in the register (licences 001-387, list runs to Oct 2026). The register gives a single free-text 'Adresa' (town, or street + town, sometimes several offices) and a contact phone; appraisers whose Adresa has a street but no town (1) were dropped because town is required. Appraisers with several listed offices have one row per office. Association membership and disciplinary measures in the register were not carried over.
